Task landed. Summary:

**Landed: `ui, ux: land the System conversion`** — commit `5f183d1f` on `worktree/ui-system`, not merged (that's the parent task's job).

The uncommitted conversion of [`ui/page.js`](http://ui-system.localhost/framework/ui/) and [`ux/page.js`](http://ui-system.localhost/framework/ux/) from `Doc`/`Page` to the new `System` class checked out correct — no bugs found, nothing needed fixing. Verified live, headless, at 400/1200/1920/3440:

- Zero console errors on both pages at all four widths, and on `/framework/ui/card/`, `/framework/ux/Tree/`, both doc pages, and both Inbox tabs.
- All 28 `ui/` + 14 `ux/` component URLs still resolve (200).
- `ux`'s removed `route()` for "doc" is correctly replaced by `notes: "system decisions"`, which `Doc`'s `declare_note()` turns into the same `/framework/ux/doc/system/` and `/framework/ux/doc/decisions/` URLs.
- The Overview tab shows the wall, then the page's own content, then a real, non-empty Readme at the bottom — confirmed by DOM inspection since `md.details(...)` was removed from both `content()` methods.
- `ux`'s `wall(page)` helper, now using `page.parts()`, draws exactly its 14 declared classes with no Overview/Inbox/API/Docs/Files tabs leaking in.

One side item handled along the way: the worktree's own dev server had died (Servex forgot it after a restart), so I restarted it on its registered port and re-registered it with Servex — needed so the proof tools (and the parent's eventual `merge.mjs` smoke test) can reach `http://ui-system.localhost/`.

Proof shots are at `public/framework/ai/2026-09-30/ui-system/system/ui-ux-land/shots/`. Reported to the parent task (`task-mastermind-system-class`) via the landing line in my own task log, as the minion/landing convention requires.

## Done

The riskiest file in the task is landed, in the worktree only, not merged — that's the parent mastermind's job next.

**What changed:** `/framework/ai/page.js` and `/framework/ai/overview.js` — `ai/page.js` now builds a `core/System` instead of a plain `Page`, the same class `/framework/design/`, `/framework/code/`, `/framework/ui/` and `/framework/ux/` already use. Committed as `63f499cb` on `worktree/ui-system`, message "ai: becomes a System — Inbox and System tabs, via core/System".

**What it looks like:** before and after screenshots at `public/framework/ai/2026-09-30/ui-system/system/ai-convert/shots/` — the Inbox tab shows the exact same words as before, the System tab shows the exact same content as before, and `?v1` still shows the exact same old board. Only the chrome changed: the tab strip now matches every other module's docs page.

**The catch, and how I handled it:** following the brief literally would have silently broken the page — I loaded it cold and found two real problems in `core/System/System.js` itself (not guessed): its tab strip would have shown all forty of AI's dated task folders as tabs, and its render path never runs the code the brief asked for, which would have replaced `?v1`'s old board with the new tab strip. I fixed both inside `ai/page.js` alone (the brief's own allowed fallback), and wrote up the exact evidence in the task log and in a full report to `task-mastermind-system-class`, the parent task.

**Left open, on purpose:** a few unrelated pages (`/framework/ai/objects/`, `/framework/ai/authoring/`, the design-code task page) already had a stale 404 before I ever touched anything — confirmed identical screenshots before and after. I found its root cause (a hardcoded, now-missing file path in `overview.js`'s Objects tab demo) and left it for whoever owns that file, since it's outside this task's two-file fence.
